name: Tim Wilson
title: Public affairs and corporate communications specialist
bio_short: Public affairs and communications specialist with more than 25 years' experience. Former Director of Policy at Pact. Clients include Microsoft, Channel 4 and Roche. CIPR member and Royal Television Society member. UK-based. Trains in English.
bio: Tim is a public affairs and communications specialist with more than 25 years' experience across private, public, trade association and voluntary sectors. He runs Tim Wilson Associates, providing strategic public affairs and communications counsel to a wide range of clients.  Tim was formerly Director of Policy at Pact, the trade association for independent TV and film production companies, where he led successful lobbying campaigns to protect producers' intellectual property rights, including at EU level. Earlier in his career he was a senior consultant at Westminster Strategy and Political Context, delivering programmes for clients including Microsoft, Roche Pharmaceuticals and Eutelsat. He has also worked as a political researcher at Westminster and in NHS health promotion campaigns, giving him first-hand understanding of how government, parliament and the legislative process work in practice.  At ISOC, Tim delivers public affairs, government relations and corporate communications programmes. His experience operating at the interface between business, government and media makes him particularly valuable for organisations that need to influence policy, manage political stakeholders or navigate regulatory environments. He is a member of the Chartered Institute of Public Relations and the Royal Television Society, and has served as a board director of the Educational Recording Agency, Audio Content Fund and AudioUK. Tim is based in the UK and trains in English.
